title: Stir Fry Delight
description: A simple and delicious Chinese-style stir fry dish made with tender beef, crunchy vegetables, and savory sauce. Perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced beef and cook for 3-4 minutes, until browned.
Remove the beef from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chopped romaine lettuce, sliced red onion, and cooked beef back into the skillet.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce and fry sauce.
Pour the sauce over the beef and vegetables, and stir to coat.
Season with salt and chili flakes to taste.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
